To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
there is a lack of agent-oriented methodologies that provide a clear mapping of the design to the implementation.
there is a gap between the analysis/design models and the implementation, and that this gap is filled by the agent-oriented programming languages.
the analysis and design of multiagent systems are not sufficiently supported by existing methodologies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of methodologies and languages for the design and implementation of multiagent systems.
the development of methodologies for the analysis and design of multiagent systems, as well as the implementation of the resulting designs.
the development of a methodology for multiagent system analysis and implementation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no such thing as a methodology for multiagent system design and implementation.
there is no such thing as a universal methodology that can be applied to all multiagent systems, because the characteristics of a multiagent system are too varied.
the development of agent-oriented methodologies is still in its infancy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to fill in the gap between the analysis models and the implementation of agent systems.
we have developed a multi-agent system development methodology that supports the development of complex systems with a high degree of autonomy and adaptability.

we have shown that it is possible to develop a complete agent-oriented methodology, which covers the whole process from the analysis to the implementation, and which is based on a formal analysis model, and a formal agent-oriented programming language.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the analysis and design phase should be more detailed, so that the implementation can be done in a straightforward way.
a development methodology for MAS must be agent-oriented and it must provide support at the implementation stage.
we need to have a better integration of the analysis, the design and the implementation models in order to be able to develop multiagent systems.
